title: portfolio-engine
description: The official showcase of portfolio-engine — an open-source Astro backbone for personal, portfolio, and editorial websites. Every section demonstrates a feature you can use in your own site.
tagline: an Astro backbone for personal sites

contact.heading: Start your own portfolio-engine site
contact.body: Paste docs/downstream/setup-with-claude.md into Claude Code and answer a handful of questions. Or open a GitHub Discussion if you want to think out loud before committing to the stack.

scheduling.label: Book a 15-minute walkthrough
scheduling.heading: Want a guided tour?
scheduling.description: Book a slot and we'll walk through your use case live — pair on the setup flow, look at your config, or talk through whether the engine fits your project.
